scripts.emulator:fresh: rm -f .env.development.local && xcrun simctl terminate booted org.jesusfilm.forgeexpo 2>/dev/null; adb shell am force-stop org.jesusfilm.forgeexpo 2>/dev/null; expo start --clear
scripts.device: IP=$(ipconfig getifaddr en0 2>/dev/null || hostname -I 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}') && [ -n "$IP" ] || { echo 'ERROR: Could not detect local IP. Are you connected to a network?'; exit 1; } && printf 'EXPO_PUBLIC_GRAPHQL_URL_ANDROID=http://%s:1337/graphql\nEXPO_PUBLIC_GRAPHQL_URL_IOS=http://%s:1337/graphql\n' "$IP" "$IP" > .env.development.local && node scripts/device.mjs
scripts.fetch-secrets: rm -f .env && doppler secrets download --project forge-mobile --config dev --format env --no-file > .env.local.tmp && mv .env.local.tmp .env.local
scripts.build: echo 'Expo app has no production bundle step; use expo export or EAS when needed.'
